text:
Maya Patel: heads-up: found CVE-2026-1122 (openssl) in runtime base. planning emergency rebuild + KMS signer rotation this Thu 02:00 PT. Need RBAC preflight + audit sink.
Eric Huang: can we do rolling canary in us-west1/us-east1? would prefer 2x small canaries then global.
Noor Rahman: which KMS key path are we promoting? current: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/signer-prod-v1
Jen Liu: propose new key signer-prod-v3 under same ring; IAM change: only iam serviceAccount:image-builder-sa and group:attest-runner@redwood can CryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter/Signer.
security-bot: Security scan: openssl < 3.2.0 vulnerable. also SBOM shows zlib old version. rebuild should minimize libs.
Maya Patel: plan: minimal rootfs rebuild, remove suid binaries, run syft sbom, in-toto predicate, cosign sign via KMS. Freeze image pushes 30m before.
Eric Huang: preflight checklist:
- build minimal base locally
- sbom via syft -> sbom.json
- cosign sign test against kms://.../signer-prod-v3
- smoke deploy in staging w/ egress blocked
- verify attestation present via attestation service
Noor Rahman: cosign command (example):
```
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/signer-prod-v3 -a sbom.json redwood/base:2026-04-02
```
Jen Liu: IAM terraform PR incoming. Log sinks: forward Cloud KMS audit logs to splunk index=security-kms and image-attest logs to audit-logstore. Include requestMetadata.callerIp in BigQuery.
SRE-bot: NOTE: add preflight to runbooks/image-rebuild-emergency.md and tag oncall rotation.
Maya Patel: fallback: if signer-prod-v3 fails, allow explicit emergency sign with signer-prod-v1 for 4h max with manual approval from Sec Eng lead + incident log entry.
Eric Huang: deploy guard: kube webhook will verify cosign signature; if missing or invalid, abort pull. Need a short window to flip to fallback and alert.
Noor Rahman: RBAC tweak: enforce workload identity impersonation instead of long-lived keys for CI runners. I'll draft workload-identity mapping.
Jen Liu: PR: infra#4380 opened (https://git.redwood/infra/terraform/pulls/4380). Adding canary rollout strategy (10% -> 50% -> 100%) and 7-day gradual IAM policy.
security-bot: Reminder: ensure sbom hash is included in in-toto predicate. Also add vulnerability gating to block rebuild if critical vulns remain.
Maya Patel: scheduling 30m preflight Wed 16:30 PT. posting notice to #release-war-room and will DM product to hold runtime releases.
Eric Huang: I'll coordinate canary windows and post timeline.
Noor Rahman: also enable alerting: if any KMS:AsymmetricSign failures > 5 in 5m, page sec-eng and SRE.
Jen Liu: ack, adding alert to pagerduty policy.
Maya Patel: thanks all. after rebuild we'll do attest + provenance embargo for 24h to monitor for regressions. :thumbsup:
